description: Live test: agent executes real tasks with new patterns (read files, search, list, create notes)

commands.description: Restart agent with latest code (kill old + start new)
commands.command: taskkill /f /im python.exe 2>nul & timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul & start /b cmd /c "cd C:\Users\97150\macal_pc && .venv\Scripts\activate && python -m src.daemon.main"

commands.description: Test: Read the hello.txt file we created earlier
commands.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8900/api/v1/task -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"instruction\": \"read hello.txt in my Documents\"}"

commands.description: Test: List files in your Organized folder
commands.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8900/api/v1/task -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"instruction\": \"list my Organized\"}"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8900/api/v1/task -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"instruction\": \"create a note called daily-log.md with Today I built an AI agent that controls my PC\"}"

commands.description: Test: Read the note we just created
commands.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8900/api/v1/task -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"instruction\": \"read daily-log.md in my Documents/Notes\"}"
